name: A Rogue's Deal
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
What?

What?!

You want money? I don't owe you any money.

Letter? What letter? Oh, you wanna fight then? All right, mate... let's do this! Owe you any money...
narrative.offerRewardText:
Incredible! What skill!

Thought you'd be easy prey, adventurer. Got me good, you did.

Here's the coin I promised... not as much as I said it'd be, but that's on a count o' me lying to ya in the first place.

chain.subtitle: 2 quests at level 5, 220 XP in all.

quests.name: A Rogue's Deal
quests.objectiveText: Deliver the Nondescript Letter to Innkeeper Renee in Tirisfal Glades.
